$comment: Contract of the Dashboard cards (escala-governance step 2): four cards on the Figma page ❖ Dashboard (PRO). Each is one shell (Surface/layer-1, Border/default, Radius/container, padding Spacing/inset-surface, gap Spacing/gap-group) filled with escala-ui components; a card draws no colour, length or type of its own. Anatomy mirrors the Figma sets; nests lists every component the card uses.

blocks.name: DashboardGaugeCard
anatomy: text: title (Type/heading-2xs) + status line (Type/body-sm, Content/secondary), gap-tight
a11y: The Gauge is role=meter and reads its value and label as one aria-valuetext

blocks.name: DashboardMetricCard
anatomy: header: label (Type/body-md, Content/secondary) + value (Type/heading-sm) + delta (Type/label, Status/success/content), baseline-aligned
a11y: The delta is written as text, never shown by colour alone
The Sparkline is role=img with a label that states the trend
The range switch is a radiogroup with one tab stop

blocks.name: DashboardActivityCard
a11y: The caption repeats what the focused day announces (aria-live polite)
The heatmap is a grid with arrow-key navigation

blocks.name: DashboardTrafficCard
anatomy: header: title (Type/heading-2xs) + description (Type/body-sm) and the total (label, Type/heading-sm value, unit)
a11y: The SplitBar is a group labelled by the card's title
Every share is also written in the legend
